facts.business: Emerald Leisures Limited operates a standalone hospitality property in Chembur, Mumbai, offering rooms, multi-cuisine pure vegetarian restaurants, banquets, and club memberships, while also developing a real estate division with projects in Chembur and Mahim.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company is confident that the division will start showing results from FY 2026-27.
